entries.zh: 得窍门；掌握（行当、手艺）的诀要
entries.en: to get the knack of a trade; to master a craft
entries.notes: L 缩写「ellof°.」推为 el ofiçio（行当、手艺）。

entries.en: camphor
to raise; to lift up; to get up
〔damaged in the original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏漫漶、M 栏残缺，仅 H「末」与 R「mort」可辨，语义无从定夺。

entries.zh: 硬争；强力争执、争夺（他人之物）
entries.en: to contend stubbornly; to fight hard over another's property
entries.notes: L「por fuer ca」为断行残文，读作 por força。

entries.en: to seize and occupy another's property; to usurp
to seize by force of power or backing
entries.notes: L 末段「confabor de Habo」漫漶，义据 H「勢占」定。

entries.en: to scheme to swallow up another's property
entries.notes: L「cin in Qustria y graicion」漫漶，义据 H「吞謀」定。

entries.en: rebellious minister; usurper of the realm
to sink; to founder; to submerge
entries.notes: L 断行残文「entrega ron」，语义关联不明，义据 H/M/R 定。

entries.en: to drown; to be submerged
entries.notes: 同第 10 条，L 栏残断，义据 H/M/R 定。

entries.en: to haul in the fishing net
entries.notes: H 栏「交網」疑为「絞網」，与 L「alçar a rede」相合。

entries.en: (of rice cakes) to rise; to swell up
entries.notes: L 末词「galança」疑指 galanga（高良薑），全句未安。

entries.en: to weigh anchor; to wind up the anchor
entries.notes: H「車捉」疑为「車碇」（碇即锚），L「alçar a ancla」相合。

entries.zh: 占算天文地理（占星、堪舆）
entries.en: to cast figures by astronomy and geography; to divine
to clear the table; to put away

entries.zh: 地牛（地面绞引/起重之具，千斤顶、地锚一类）
entries.en: ground jack or ground anchor (a heavy lifting or hauling device)
entries.notes: L「alca prima」疑为 alzaprima（千斤顶、杠杆），与 H「地牛」器具义或合，书证不足。

entries.en: a small jack; the smaller version of the same device
entries.notes: 与第 17 条同一 L 词头，H「牛仔」以「仔」表小称，所指存疑。

entries.en: to put out (fire); to wipe out
entries.notes: L 与第 10、11 条重复且残，义据 H「撲滅」定。

entries.en: sea goose (a seabird; species unidentified)
entries.notes: L 词头「Acara -」截断，与 H/M/R 不能互证。
